findings.title: Compatible replay reset a saved fractional integration grid

compatibility.explanation: Compatible model, algorithm and complete checkpoint. Resume preserves physical state, controllers, integration settings and event position.

findings.resolution: Worker requests now carry validated integrationStepS; pristine replay initializes that grid, supplied checkpoints reject a mismatch, and UI replay/seek and saved comparisons propagate the saved setting.
findings.verification: Executed full-state deep equality for the same 0.125-second, battery-discharge event scenario; replay now matches exactly after normalizing solverMs. Read added unit and browser regressions.

findings.title: Saved-scenario restoration converted JSON numeric overflow into allowed null

originalObservation.directRejected: serialized number must be a finite number within limits.

findings.resolution: Shelf reader now runs bounded JSON preflight and validates raw parsed structure before any JSON stringify can erase Infinity.
findings.verification: The same raw budgetUSD:1e309 shelf witness now throws INVALID_NUMBER. Added browser regression verifies stored bytes remain and the invalid scenario is unavailable.

findings.title: Missing electrical source asset admitted a nominal powered checkpoint
findings.resolution: Design admission now requires shore/grid and validates asset-parent, module-domain and connection endpoint/port references.
findings.verification: The missing-source initialization/export witness now rejects with DESIGN_SOURCE. Existing capacity edits and documented network boundary controls remain supported.

findings.title: Exact worker restore omitted full design validation
findings.resolution: Every numerical worker operation validates the design before accepting state, including restore.
findings.verification: The Infinity-supply, rebound-identity restore request now returns invalid-input failure without publishing state; matching regression test passes.

findings.title: Sparse grid requests returned a nominal sparse result
findings.resolution: Allocation validates every array entry including holes, and bounds actual request/domain collections with shared limits.
findings.verification: allocateGrid(Array(1),10,new Map()) now rejects as invalid input instead of serializing a successful [null] result; matching regression test passes.

findings.title: Saved comparison export dropped existing parent provenance
findings.originalObservation: compareSaved retained only design/events/state, and comparison export called projectFile without original provenance. A saved explicitly recalculated experiment therefore lost its parent identity through a compatible comparison replay.
findings.resolution: Saved comparison runs and Compared results carry source provenance, and comparison export passes it into projectFile before serializeProject.
findings.verification: Verified the full source propagation path and the added browser assertion comparing exported provenance to the saved derived project. Browser execution is owned by the integration/worker verification, not claimed as an independent run here.

findings.title: Shelf writer lacked the aggregate reader admission checks
findings.originalObservation: The shelf reader enforced the shared total byte/structure ceiling, while the writer only validated each project. If a storage backend accepted the larger aggregate, successful writes could become unreadable. This was a source-level contract mismatch, not a reproduced quota-success claim on this browser.
findings.resolution: Shelf writer now checks aggregate serialized preflight and complete collection structure before setItem and before acknowledging the new shelf.
findings.verification: Source inspection confirms both aggregate checks precede storage mutation and setSaved. Individual valid projects remain independently exportable on collection/storage failure.

findings.title: Connected electrical port with bit/s units still produced nominal watts
findings.resolution: Shared design validation now checks the unit for every declared medium and compatible power input/output directions and media.
findings.verification: The connected shore/grid power-out unit witness now rejects with PORT_UNIT. The 32,000/32,008 accelerator shared-network controls remain exact.
